subject: runApp() crashes R session on OS X Mavericks with R version 3.1.1

messages.author: 34b9da745fe3a853
messages.subject: runApp() crashes R session on OS X Mavericks with R version 3.1.1
parts:
I am trying to use runApp() to run a Shiny app locally from RSudio but R crashes with the message: 

"R Session Aborted. 
R encountered a fatal error.
The session was terminated" 

runExample("01_hello") also results in the crash. R is version 3.1.1 and RStudio is version 0.98.1028.

messages.subject: Re: runApp() crashes R session on OS X Mavericks with R version 3.1.1
parts:
I have narrowed the problem down to a single line in a renderPlot() function in the server.R file:

ggplot(data2, aes_string(x=input$x, y=input$y)) + geom_point()

library(ggplot2) is called at the top of the file along with library(shiny). x and y are both from two selectInput() functions in the ui.R and have default values and their values are both columns in the data frame, data2. Running the code outside shiny works as expected.

Interesting. The issue should be irrelevant to the base64enc package,
since shiny does not use it. Instead, caTools::base64encode() is used.
If you need to reinstall anything, you should reinstall bitops
package. Or just reinstall everything:

install.packages(rownames(installed.packages(priority = 'NA')))

Regards,
Yihui

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: runApp() crashes R session on OS X Mavericks with R version 3.1.1
parts: Reinstalling all packages eliminated the issue.

On Wednesday, August 20, 2014 1:02:35 PM UTC-4, Yihui Xie wrote:
Interesting. The issue should be irrelevant to the base64enc package,
since shiny does not use it. Instead, caTools::base64encode() is used.
If you need to reinstall anything, you should reinstall bitops
package. Or just reinstall everything:

    install.packages(rownames(installed.packages(priority = 'NA')))

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name
